0599 'anaph {a:-naf'}

字根型; TWOT - 133; 動詞

欽定本 - angry 13, displeased 1; 14

1) 生氣

   1b) (Hithpael) 發怒 (一定指耶和華)
record.edic_text:
0599 'anaph {aw-naf'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 133; v

AV - angry 13, displeased 1; 14

1) to be angry, to be displeased, to breathe hard

   1b) (Hithpael) to be angry (always of God)
